description: Returns an UNSIGNED Nostr kind 422 'shopping experience' event template for a store, for you to sign with your own (ideally site-specific) key and publish to your own relays. KlickyMart never signs or publishes for you. Optionally POST the signed event to /reviews (or the submit_review tool). Location must be ZIP3, US state (US-KS) or country only. Proof tags (zap/preimage/cashu/order_hash = sha256 of the confirmation) mark a verified purchase. preset=checkout (record_checkout): one call at the payment screen records subtotal, shipping and tax for a ZIP3; depth is then optional.

basis.description: visit = you went to the store; directory = written from KlickyMart data; secondhand = relayed; omitted = unknown. Only visit counts toward the chart.

depth.description: furthest stage reached (same stages as checkout maps; 'attempt' accepted as an alias)

estimated.description: true = every amount you give is an estimate; false = none; or a list of amount kinds you estimated (array or comma string, e.g. tax,total)

fee.description: a store or payment fee, e.g. a gift-card fee

pay_offered.description: vocab codes; an empty list means you looked and saw none (tagged none-observed); omit if not checked

pay_used.description: vocab pay code (see /vocab.json), e.g. ln, btc, card, spay

preset.description: checkout = record_checkout: call once at the payment screen, before paying. Needs region (ZIP3 only), price_seen (subtotal), shipping, tax; total optional and checked. Sets basis=visit, depth=payment, shipping_source=checkout. 2+ independent aged keys are needed before a quote drives est_total on /landed.

price.description: the item price you saw (alias price_seen)

price_paid.description: what you actually paid, if you paid

price_source.description: price copied from KlickyMart data or read on the store

shipping_source.description: where the shipping amount came from: the store's shipping policy, the checkout itself, or unknown

shown_before_payment.description: comma list: tax, shipping, none, not-observed or unknown

strict.description: reject unknown fields instead of ignoring them with a warning

name: build_experience_note
